note: Sample content for the deck sample tool, invented people, organisations and figures only. For a length and a language the tool reads the brief (and source_text) as the customer’s message, takes the entry’s slots with skeleton.slots over the brief’s cues, and fills slide i from slides[<its slot>]: the k-th time a slot repeats takes item k, starting again from the first when the list is shorter. A slot whose heading is fixed carries an empty heading, which the finish writes in the language of the deck. Customer slots hold only what the brief says (figures) or an honest form (topic_only); notes are left to the real model.

brief.uz: «O‘quvchilarning o‘qish savodxonligini oshirish» mavzusida pedagogik kengashda ma’ruza qilaman. Ma’ruzachi — metodbirlashma rahbari.
brief.ru: Выступаю на педсовете с докладом «Повышение читательской грамотности учащихся». Докладчик — руководитель методического объединения.
brief.en: I am giving a talk at the teachers’ council on “Improving pupils’ reading literacy”. The presenter is the head of the methodological group.
